crossRefs.note: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one…
He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.
He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements;
“ ‘ “But when the people of the land come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north…
The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure…
Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;
with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches…

translations.web: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.
translations.bsb: Then he led me to the south side, and I saw a gateway facing south. He measured its side pillars and portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.
translations.kjv: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
translations.asv: And he led me toward the south; and, behold, a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
